summary: Jon Postel's note on the effect of satellite links on the ARPANET. A satellite path adds much more delay without necessarily lowering the data rate. He notes that interactive use with character-at-a-time remote echo is already marginal on the surface network. He asks users to think about how this affects interactive services.

eli5.summary: A message that goes up to space and back takes much longer than one down a wire. This note warns that talking in real time with a faraway computer will feel slow when satellites are used.

questions: why satellite links hurt remote echo
